target.name: wellfit-bewegt
target.historical_version_note: Version 105 belongs to the previous renderer generation and must not be treated as DOM-bound acceptance evidence.

required_source_files.role: single active DOM-bound Rudi runtime controller
WellFit letter anchors including initial F podium
reusable Rudi surface metadata on section headings
current landing section structure and corrected Buddy-care alt text

must: Rudi starts by climbing onto the F and may stand on it as a podium.
Rudi footing follows the exact bound DOM surface while the page scrolls.
Rudi may leave the viewport completely with his bound surface.
Catch-up begins only after the old surface is fully offscreen and scrolling has settled.
Catch-up and autonomous relocation use visibly grounded horizontal-walk, vertical-climb and landing segments.
Narrow explicit letters and thin lines or ledges remain usable surfaces.
CTA attention changes gaze or body response without relocating Rudi through empty space.
Back-layer behavior paints below normal landing content; front-layer behavior remains below the sticky header.
Reduced-motion preference uses the static DOM-bound fallback.
Sub-desktop viewports do not mount the 3D world.
Canvas and Rudi layers do not intercept landing controls.
must_not: air climbing without a visible physical route
eager GLTF preloading on hidden or reduced-motion presentation

checks.check: Initial F climb is visibly grounded
Feet remain aligned with the bound surface during scrolling
Rudi leaves the viewport with an offscreen bound surface
Catch-up uses a visible grounded route and no teleport
Surface-to-surface journeys visibly walk, climb, then land
Front/back occlusion is believable and header remains unobscured
CTA gaze does not move Rudi off his surface
No floating, free-flight, viewport pinning or air-climbing is visible

site_acceptance.publication_rule: Do not publish or mark WFG-RUDI-WORLD-001 ACCEPTED unless every required check passes on the exact editable wellfit-bewegt Site preview.

next_action: Load the exact editable wellfit-bewegt Site source, apply this immutable source contract, run the site_acceptance checks, correct any perceptual defects, and publish deliberately only after all required checks pass.
no_duplicate_rule: Do not create another Rudi controller or another landing implementation. Synchronize from the pinned WellFit-now merge and preserve one active DOM-bound world model.
